sources.snippet: Model Card for Qwen3-1.7B (Aria Quant Bundle, q4) Model Details Model Description Qwen3 1.7B is a 1.7-billion-parameter, dense Transformer decoder-only language model developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud, pre-trained on diverse public corpora and aligned via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO).

sources.title: Qwen3-1.7B — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B is a text generation model developed by Alibaba's Qwen team and released in mid-2025, building on the Qwen3 base model architecture. It excels at conversational AI tasks and general text generation with strong instruction-following capabilities, making it suitable for chatbot applications and interactive dialogue systems.
